answer.observed_code: brain_server.py defines the Starlette application brain_server.app, which mounts mcp.streamable_http_app() and passes /mcp requests through to the MCP evidence transport. proxy/app.py defines the separate FastAPI application proxy.app.app, titled "LM Studio Stateful Chat Proxy"; its telemetry mapping names inference endpoints including /v1/chat/completions and /v1/embeddings.
answer.documented_role: AGENTS.md identifies the LM Studio inference proxy as a separate, optional compatibility layer.
answer.inference: These are two API surfaces within the same repository and product stack: the brain application serves repository evidence through MCP, while the proxy application provides the optional inference compatibility API.
